items.title: Meghan to co-host Junior MasterChef Australia

sentences.en: The Duchess of Sussex says she "can't wait" to take part in the programme, which will air next year.

items.title: Romantasy fans turn out for 'Midnight Maas' release event

sentences.en: The highly anticipated, latest installment of Sarah J.
Maas' romantasy series has hit the shelves.
Hardcore fans were lined up (in their faerie ears) at the stroke of midnight.

items.title: Polymarket has investigated 'dozens' of election-related cases

sentences.en: The prediction market has hired a former FBI official to make sure political insiders don't use the platform for profit from confidential election information.<strong> </strong>

items.title: Netherlands pulls out of Eurovision again over Israel participation

sentences.en: A Dutch broadcaster reverses a decision to take part, citing "sensitivities" over Israel's participation.

items.title: Filmmaking is 'our weapon against intolerance,' say 'La Bola Negra' directors

sentences.en: Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi have turned four pages of an unfinished play by Federico García Lorca into a sweeping epic that spans 90 years of Spanish history, focusing on the stories of gay men.

items.title: AI giant Anthropic files for an IPO that could break records

sentences.en: The AI company, which makes the popular Claude chatbot, has filed for an initial public offering that could be one of the biggest ever.
